purpose: Design document defining the doc-link composition of 8 SKILLs and 2 custom Agents: responsibilities, check findings handling, use cases, per-SKILL sequences, operational flow, and Agent data exchange.
summary: Overview table of 8 SKILLs (embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs, resolve-dlid, check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact) with write permissions and requirement mapping
Custom Agents: toc-updater (generates document info, max 3 documents per launch) and query-worker (ToC-based search)
Responsibilities of operation and lookup SKILLs, including DLID embedding, ToC build, search and DLID resolution
Check SKILLs: detected states and who handles findings with what, including link rewriting after user approval
check-impact output: changed documents with direct referrers, content hash comparison, no notification state
Use case diagram for user, project management AI and caller skills
Sequence diagrams for each SKILL (3.1 to 3.8)
Operational flow starting from index-docs, common to introduction and later changes
Data exchange with custom Agents: identifiers, request, result, error value, script validation, deletion timing
tasks: Designing check-dlid, check-links, check-toc or check-impact behavior
Reviewing SKILL sequences and operational flow
Implementing Agent request and result exchange
title: DES-010 SKILL と Agent の構成
